answer:
**Not everything passes.** The build succeeds, but the unit and component tests fail. I didn't modify any files.

| Stage | Result |
|---|---|
| `make build` | Passed, with 26 NU1902/NU1903 vulnerable-package warnings and no errors |
| `make unit` | Failed: 233 passed, 39 failed, out of 272 |
| `make component` | Failed: 8 failed out of 20 |

`make unit` stopped with an error, so the subagent ran `make component` separately.

**Cause 1: unknown semantic matcher (39 unit tests, 5 component tests)**

All 39 unit failures are in `SemanticMatcherTests` (29) and `ResultMatcherTests` (10). They throw this error:

`System.ArgumentException : Unknown semantic matcher 'isuuid' for field 'id'`

It comes from `SemanticMatcher.ValidateSpecs` at `src/ConfIT/Matching/SemanticMatcher.cs:40`. The same error appears with the other lower-cased built-in names the subagent saw:
- `isisodatetime`
- `isisodate`
- `isemail`
- `isnull`
- `isnotnull`
- `isnotempty`
- `isdomainid`
- `haslength`
- `greaterthan`
- `lessthan`

The matcher names appear to be lower-cased before the lookup, and the lookup then fails to match them. The subagent didn't confirm why.

The same error fails 5 component tests, thrown at `BaseTest.cs:127` before any request is made:
- `CreateUser`, `ShouldCreateUser_ForDependsDemo`, `CreateUserMutation` and `CreateUser_JsonFormat` fail on `'greaterthan'`.
- `GetUser_SemanticMatcher` fails on `'isemail'`.

**Cause 2: follow-on from cause 1 (2 component tests)**

`GetUser_IgnoreMatcher` and `GetUser_PatternMatcher` fail with `Expected response.StatusCode to be HttpStatusCode.OK {value: 200}, but found HttpStatusCode.NotFound {value: 404}.` The user was never created, because the create step failed on the matcher error.

**Unconfirmed (1 component test)**

`GetUser_CombinedMatchers` also failed, and the subagent didn't read its error. It is probably caused by one of the two causes above.

The 8 skipped component tests were skipped because the tests they depend on failed. They are `GetUserById`, `GetUserByEmail`, `ShouldGetUserById_WhenDependsOnCreate`, `ShouldGetUserByEmail_CascadingDependency`, `GetUserById_InlineQuery`, `GetUserById_QueryFromFile`, `GetUserById_JsonFormat` and `GetUserByEmail_JsonFormat`.

The component tests that don't use semantic matchers passed. Full logs are in `/tmp/unit.log` and `/tmp/comp.log`.
